history.summary: An 861sqft freehold 2BR at $2.30M / $2,671 PSF in Arina East Residences (D15 Tanjong Rhu, 2027/28 completion), 440m from Katong Park TEL station, priced below both the $3,008 launch average and the $2,784 median. The first new launch in Tanjong Rhu in 13 years, freehold and near a new TEL stop, but premium PSF and an uncompleted-build (progress-payment) profile temper the case.
history.rating_rationale: This $2,671 PSF sits below the confirmed ~$3,008 launch average and the $2,784 median, so it's a relatively well-priced stack in the project — and freehold tenure, a 440m walk to the new Katong Park TEL station, the Tanjong Rhu/GSW-adjacent location and rarity (first launch there in 13 years) are genuine positives. Against that: $2,671 PSF is a high absolute basis, the $2.30M new-build 2BR carries the usual new-launch developer pricing (no resale track record yet), and exit by 2032-2034 depends on the area's premium holding. A credible long hold, but the rich entry PSF keeps it Neutral rather than Buy.
